findings.title: Crafted public Blog URL may freeze the victim browser tab
findings.impact: Client tab availability; no server/account compromise established.
findings.validation: Bounded isolated process timing; no crafted production request.
findings.treatment: Explicit length bound and a shared linear validator for URL and API slugs; fix-release verification remains separate.

findings.title: Unreleased Windows desktop prototype may select project-planted executables
findings.impact: Requires attacker-controlled existing local project files and deliberate use of the unreleased prototype. Not reachable through the web bridge.
findings.treatment: Permanent web-only lifecycle and fail-closed documented desktop entry points. Historical source retained, never a shipped desktop product.

runtime.limits: Synthetic export authorization was only a local fixture, not a live quota bypass.
